name: dsh-cookie-pruner
description: DSH 桌面端 dsh-auth-* cookie 累积（HTTP 431 / Web authentication failed 启动崩溃） prevention 插件。v0.1.9 修复了 v0.1.7/v0.1.8 的真正回归：push() 直接读取 ctx.settings（vm 沙箱里为 undefined）导致 Host 半边从未发布数据、面板一直「插件尚未就绪」；改为 ctx.get('settings') 后首条数据必定落地。v0.1.10 修复沙箱两处硬限制：process 在沙箱里为 undefined（改用子进程探测 $env:APPDATA），裸 setTimeout/setInterval 被拦截（改用 ctx.timeout/ctx.interval 并声明 inject:['timer']）。v0.1.11 修复第三处沙箱坑：子进程句柄的 handle.done 只解析成 {exitCode,signal}（不带 .stdout），v0.1.10 误读 res.stdout 导致永远测出 0 KB；改为直接用 node:fs 读文件大小（实测 28672 字节 / 28 KB），子进程兜底通道也从 handle.stdout 流读取。自动检测 + 退出后自动清理：周期性读 Cookies 库大小，检测到堆积时自动登记 Windows 计划任务，在你完全退出 DSH 后 ≤10 分钟自动运行 cleanup-once.ps1。同时提供「账户 → 设置 → Cookie 清理」分区。Layer A（cookieMaxAgeDays:7）已在生效。 / DSH desktop dsh-auth-* cookie pile-up (HTTP 431) prevention. v0.1.9 fixes the real v0.1.7/v0.1.8 regression (push() read ctx.settings, undefined in the vm sandbox). v0.1.10 fixes two sandbox hard-limits: process is undefined (resolve APPDATA via subprocess probe) and bare setTimeout/setInterval are trapped (use ctx.timeout/ctx.interval + inject:['timer']). v0.1.11 fixes the third sandbox pitfall: sub.spawn handle.done resolves to {exitCode,signal} only (no .stdout), so v0.1.10's res.stdout read always returned 0 KB; now uses node:fs statSync to read the file size directly (measured 28672 bytes / 28 KB) with a subprocess fallback that streams from handle.stdout. Auto-detect via DB size + deferred auto-cleanup through a Task Scheduler job after DSH fully exits. No runtime deletion (sandbox + locked DB), genuine prevention without manual steps.
